newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares tumble, losses seen overdone.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares tumble, losses seen overdone.

text.p: Austrian shares took a battering on Thursday, dropping below the psychologically important 1,400 point level in volatile trade but traders saw the losses as overdone and predicted a more friendly market next week.
"The losses of the last few days were definitely exaggerated," said one trader.
Dealers were cautiously optimistic about next week, on the grounds that support at 1,380 points had proved strong.
"We definitely won't make up 50 points in two days," said one about trade next week. "I would envisage the ATX around 1,420 points," he added.
The market will be closed on Friday for ascension day.
* ATX down 25.39 points or 1.8 pct at 1,382.75.
* Leading ATX decliner microchip maker AMS, down 3.93 pct at 1,075 ats.
* Leading gainer Bank Austria preferred, up 1.26 pct at 483 ats
* August ATX future closed down 20.6 points at 1,385.0 on its expiry.
